title: Chapter 155 Gold Devouring Demonic Bug Mira
content:
Chapter 155 Gold Devouring Demonic Bug Mira

And the gold boss in front of him is far inferior to Toad Brunei.

[Gold Devouring Demon Bug (ID Bug 00001 Mira, Gold Boss)]

[Level: Level 32]

[Attack Power: 200]

[Defense Power: 200]

[HP: 9000]

[Skills: Hallucination, Soul Stripping, Egg Explosion]

[Note: Mira was originally a dead gold devouring demon bug, but her soul was not extinguished. After countless years and at a huge cost, she was resurrected from the dead. This is when she is the weakest. ]

Wang Shuo saw this introduction and couldn't help but secretly feel lucky.

This Mira must have been extremely powerful before, but now she is in a weak period, which gives him a chance.

Without hesitation, Wang Shuo immediately ordered: "Prepare for battle, use the Soul Defense Talisman."

The Soul Defense Talisman happens to be the nemesis of her two important skills.

This is also an important reason why Wang Shuo dared to fight her.

After all, it was a tough fight against a gold boss, so Wang Shuo was very careful.

He arranged Li Jianguo at the entrance of a passage and set up a bronze crossbow cart.

This kind of big killer weapon is so cool to use to fight the boss.

Gong Zheng was petrified and pushed forward.

As for the remaining two silver bosses, Ayub dealt with one and Wang Shuo dealt with one.

After changing his job as a general, Wang Shuo's basic attributes have surpassed Ayub, and the combat effectiveness of the two is now comparable.

As for the other cavalry, they assisted Wang Shuo and Ayub and attacked the two silver bosses.

The silver boss Wang Shuo dealt with was a 2-meter-long ant-shaped monster.

It had four legs on the ground, and in the front two legs, it held a fork and a shield weapon.

It looked very strange.

If it was a silver boss in the form of other large animals, Wang Shuo might not dare to attack head-on, but Wang Shuo was still confident about this silver boss of the Zerg.

Wang Shuo's "Dragon Spear Art" is almost at level 4. After using the Flame Spear for a long time, he has mastered the use of the spear.

With a flick of the spear, the shield was deflected, and with a push of both hands, the spear pierced the neck of the ant boss.

However, due to the protection of the hard shell, it did not cause any damage to the ant boss.

Through this tentative attack, Wang Shuo already had the confidence to defeat him.

It is said that ants are extremely powerful, but Wang Shuo feels that it is just so-so.

In fact, this is all because the gold-eating demon worm consumed a lot of resources and did not focus on cultivating these two bosses.

Most of the resources of the entire ancient battlefield were used by the gold-eating demon worm to resurrect itself.

Unexpectedly, she had just resurrected and had not yet passed the weak period, and she encountered Wang Shuo. At this time, she stared at Gong Zheng angrily, with endless anger in her eyes.

The gold-eating demon worm found that she could not cause fatal damage to Gong Zheng, which surprised her.

As time went by, a bronze spear shot out from a distance and directly stabbed the ant boss on the cave wall.

Wang Shuo rushed forward and cut off his head directly.

Wang Shuo turned his head to look at Ayub, and the health of the other spider boss was about to run out.

"Human, leave now, I can forgive you for the past."

Wang Shuo sneered, he was already at the end of his strength, but he still had the audacity to speak so arrogantly.

"No need to struggle fearlessly, today is your death day." After Wang Shuo finished speaking, he rushed forward with a gun and attacked the gold-eating demon worm fiercely.

Because the gold-eating demon worm's whole body is like a huge silkworm pupa, all the attacks come from the mouth, so it is still easy to deal with.

But her shell is also very hard. Wang Shuo stabbed her body several times, but failed to break her defense.

He could only stab into her mouth.
